title: createRouter
summary: Create a navigation-only router with no loader/action engine.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: routes contains URL patterns and components. Data handlers and shouldRevalidate are excluded by the NavigationRoute type. options accepts url and browser; browser defaults to false.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Use the same components and location/parameter hooks with either router. Create the instance outside component rendering.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A NavigationRouter with routes, getSnapshot, subscribe, start, navigate and dispose. It has no submit, createFetcher or revalidate methods. Initial route matching is synchronous, including during SSR.

sections.title: History and lifecycle
sections.body: browser: true enables pushState/replaceState navigation and listens for popstate and hashchange while a provider is mounted. An unmatched URL renders the Routes fallback. External imperative destinations are ignored; external links retain browser behavior. dispose releases subscriptions and history listeners.

sections.title: Add data flow
sections.body: Choose createDataRouter for loaders, actions, fetchers, cancellation, revalidation and data hydration. Application/file-router hydration helpers already use createDataRouter. Navigation-only routing does not execute handlers or manage scroll/view-transition integrations.
